ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَقِنَا شَرَّ الْحُسَّادِ وَأَهْلَ الْبَغْيِ وَالْعِنَادِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa qinā sharra ‘l-ḥussādi wa ahla ‘l-baghyi wa ‘l-`inād.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and save us from the evil of the jealous and those of outrage and obstinacy!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَأَصْلِحْ وُلَاةَ أُمُوْرِنَا بِالْعَدْلِ وَالسَّدَادِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa aṣliḥ wulāta umūrinā bi ‘l-`adli wa ‘s-sadād.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and rectify the executors of our affairs with justice and appropriateness!
